Method of Attack: Inject malicious JavaScript-based scripts (web skimmers or e-skimmers) into checkout pages to collect customers' payment info and send it to attacker-controlled remote sites
Attack Vector: Exploitation of vulnerabilities in e-commerce platforms to inject malicious code within the CMS
Use of third-party ecommerce platforms infected with malware
Indicators of Compromise: Credit cards used on Hanna Andersson website available for purchase on dark web
Malware infection on Salesforce Commerce Cloud platform
Malicious JavaScript-based scripts on checkout pages
